text_block_list.text: While strolling leisurely through the town—

Waaaah!
Game over again~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, we are getting the hang of it.
Let us regroup and try again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is a co-op gun shooting game,
"Buddy Hazard."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reports indicate that clearing the highest difficulty
today rewards a plushie of the mascot
character, "Kumohaza-kun."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really want Kumohaza-kun!
But it's so hard~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us pause for a breath before turning the
next corner. This time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah!
A pincer attack this time~!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please dodge!
That is a feint...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Progression rate is steadily increasing. However...
choice_data_list: It's really tough to clear, huh.
It's really tough to clear, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Clearing it requires high concentration. Due to repeated
trial and error, their levels are currently dropping.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I am only permitted to
maintain the status of "Observer."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That is—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will execute and accomplish this mission without fail.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Wait, huh!? Aren't both the enemies
and Bourbon-san moving really weirdly!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Incomprehensible. The moment contact was initiated,
the arcade cabinet initiated an unexpected action—

text_block_list.name: Arcade Machine
text_block_list.text:
"BEEP-SKRRR-BZZT!!
*Chime* ♪ ——Please call an attendant."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Subsequently, repeated attempts produced
continuous errors. The arcade issued an order
prohibiting me from further play.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Therefore, direct intervention is impossible for me.
choice_data_list: Then let's send them strength by cheering!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Cheering...
choice_data_list: You know how reassuring cheers can be, right?
You know how reassuring cheers can be, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Cheering...
choice_data_list: You know how reassuring cheers can be, right?
You know how reassuring cheers can be, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
'Lightning Training'... Back then, Bakushin O-san,
Laurel-san, and the others cheered for me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Their presence granted me courage,
allowing me to take steps toward overcoming lightning.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, cheering provides strength.
This time, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Please!
I believe in your victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-We did itttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! It's all thanks to Ikuno's
guidance and Bourbon-san's cheering!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My gratitude as well.
When we were about to falter, Bourbon-san's
cheering restored our vitality.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, there is no need for thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cheering imparts tremendous power upon the recipient—
I have re-learned this lesson today.

Mihono Bourbon congratulated their victory with a gentle smile.
At the same time, she seemed to be recalling
her friends who had once cheered for her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. I clearly remember how reassuring
it felt to receive cheers while running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
More power welled up than usual,
allowing me to overcome difficult situations.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, cheering provides reassurance.
This time, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Please!
I believe in your victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-We did itttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! It's all thanks to Ikuno's
guidance and Bourbon-san's cheering!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My gratitude as well.
When we were about to falter, Bourbon-san's
cheering restored our vitality.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, there is no need for thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cheering strongly supports the recipient's spirit—
I have re-learned this lesson today.

Mihono Bourbon congratulated their victory with a gentle smile.
At the same time, she seemed to be recalling
the audience who had once cheered for her.
